description: Deterministic Fiduccia–Mattheyses passes for bounded hypergraph bipartitioning.

source.primary: C. M. Fiduccia and R. M. Mattheyses, A Linear-Time Heuristic for Improving Network Partitions, DAC 1982, pp. 175–181, DOI 10.1109/DAC.1982.1585498
source.reuse: Algorithmic idea only; independently authored bounded contract and implementations.

input.repeated_nets: allowed and treated as distinct nets

algorithm_details.legal_move: Block A size after the move is in [n/2-1,n/2+1].
algorithm_details.gain: Current cut-net count minus cut-net count after moving the vertex.
algorithm_details.selection: Highest gain from buckets [-m,m], including nonpositive gains; ties use lower resulting abs(2*size_A-n), then lower vertex ID.
algorithm_details.pass: Lock each selected vertex once until no legal unlocked move remains; retain the earliest prefix with minimum cut count, including prefix zero; accept only a strict improvement.
algorithm_details.termination: Repeat passes until one does not strictly improve the starting cut count.
algorithm_details.primary_oracle: Recompute each unlocked vertex gain by scanning its incident nets.
algorithm_details.independent_oracle: Recount every net for every legal candidate move, then replay the same deterministic choices.
algorithm_details.port_bucket_policy: Rebuild deterministic bounded gain buckets after each move.
algorithm_details.complexity: O(m*n^3) per pass for pin-rescanning ports; O(m*n^2) per pass for net-mask ports; at most m improving passes plus one terminal pass, conservative O(m^2*n^3) time and O(m*n+n) workspace.
